name: Chengqing Robotics
summary: Chengqing Robotics is a Shanghai company developing humanoid robots for learning and companionship. Its DaCheng brand combines a small articulated robot body with voice interaction and app control for educational use. The company describes work on multimodal interaction, humanoid mechanical structures and education applications, and lists an operating office in Shanghai’s Huangpu District.
